what: A WebGL2 noise band is laid behind the panel — a domain-warp fbm flowing outward from one point (origin, default top center) (scale 1.25 · octaves 4.5 · swirl .25), layered in two phases (.15 cycles/s) so it flows endlessly, while the grain itself shifts at .35 speed. It is colored with three color stops (.2 · .85 · 1) and fades to transparent from one end along the curve (.42,0,.58,1) (.35 → 1). Where the cursor passes, a small flow field pushes the grain so it flows like water (decaying by .98 each step), colors split along the flow direction (.15), and the grain is pulled .15 toward the cursor. With spot, only the area around the cursor (.35) is strong and the rest stays at .66. With iris, it shows only as a noise-edged cloud 2.5x wider horizontally from top center (sub-page header). Drawn at low resolution (.25) and stretched into a blur. Pauses when off-screen

options.--fx-c1 · --fx-c2 · --fx-c3: Three colors (CSS variables, color-mix allowed) — default is a lavender made by mixing the accent into the background at 22·50·70%
options.stops: Three color positions (0 to 1 ascending), default 0.2,0.85,1
options.speed · morph · flow: Scroll speed · texture-change speed · distance travelled per loop, defaults .15 · .35 · .75
options.scale · octaves · warp: Grain size · layer count (1~6) · twist, default 1.25 · 4.5 · .25
options.origin: Emission point x,y (0 to 1, bottom is 0), default ”0.5,1” — to have it rise from below the panel use ”0.5,-0.2”
options.fade · ease · from: Fade start and end (ratio of panel height), curve, reference edge (top|bottom), defaults 0.35,1 · 0.42,0,0.58,1 · top
options.ref: Reference height (px) — when the panel is larger than this, the grain size stays the same and a wider area is shown, default 0 (off). The original panel is 640
options.chroma · distort · follow · dissip · for: Color split · force of the flow pushing the grain · cursor pull · share of flow that remains · cursor force, defaults .15 · .35 · .15 · .98 · 1
options.spot · spot-center · spot-edge · spot-ra: Darken only around the cursor (1 turns it on) · cursor-spot darkness · rest darkness · radius · softness, off by default · 1 · .66 · .35 · .5
options.iris · iris-width · iris-noise · iris-fe: Top center cloud mask radius (0 turns it off, sub pages .55) · horizontal stretch · edge noise · softness · center height, defaults 0 · 2.5 · .3 · .4 · 1
options.res · blur: Drawing resolution scale · blur (px), default .25 · 6 — the original large board uses .1 · 2 texels
options.seed: Different pattern from the same option, default 0
options.fx:boost: Sent to the element, it speeds up to 1+amount (default 2.25) times in .4s and returns in 4.6s — for page turns
options.fx:recolor: Send it after changing clothes and the color is read again

note: The original builds the flow field with a GPU fluid solver (pressure and vorticity). Here a 48×28 cell flow field is spread on the CPU and only left to decay, so swirls curl less. The original’s ambient wobble is not included
